Synopsis:
A shooting at a techno rave in Aarau, Switzerland killed one 22-year-old Italian woman and injured five others. Authorities are treating terrorism, mass shooting, and criminal motive as equally likely. A nationwide manhunt is ongoing. Two calibres of ammunition were found, suggesting multiple weapons. The event drew ~3,500 attendees.
